description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller named PermissionController, which manages permission-related web endpoints within an admin interface. It handles displaying permissions, paging through permission data, and sets up menu context, though some methods are incomplete or not implemented.

classes.name: PermissionController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing permission views and data for the admin interface, including permission listing and paging.

methods.name: displayPermissions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the permissions page; currently throws a 'Not implemented' exception.

methods.name: pagePermissions
methods.description: Handles POST requests for paginated permission data, returns JSON with permission entries.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets menu context attributes for the view; currently unused.
